headline: HoverAir’s transforming modular drone has already been halted in the US
summary: US sales of the HoverAir Versa drone were halted just three days after its Indiegogo launch. The FCC's drone ban appears to have blocked the modular steadycam drone. This decision may force the company to abandon US shipping plans.

headline: TikTok will pay $400 million to settle DOJ child privacy lawsuit
summary: TikTok will pay $400 million to settle a 2024 DOJ lawsuit. The lawsuit alleged TikTok violated COPPA by collecting children's data without parental consent. TikTok also failed to delete these accounts as required.

headline: Over 1 million people have clicked LinkedIn’s AI slop button
summary: LinkedIn introduced a 'Seems like AI slop' button on July 30th. Over one million users have already clicked the button. This feature helps users report AI-generated low-quality content.

headline: Apple is laying off staffers working on the Vision Pro and Siri
summary: Apple is cutting over 200 jobs across its Vision Pro and Siri teams. The Vision Pro gaming team is largely shutting down. The immersive content team for Vision Pro is also being reduced.

headline: The Sinking City 2 Review
summary: The Sinking City 2 is reviewed as a commendable imitation of Resident Evil. It successfully blends its inspirations with the Cthulhu mythos. The game feels like an 'off-brand' but praiseworthy horror experience.

headline: Arc Raiders Players Torn After Embark Delays Future Expeditions Until Early 2027
summary: Embark Studios delayed all future Arc Raiders Expeditions until early 2027. The delay aims to implement major improvements based on community feedback. Players express mixed feelings, hoping for significant changes.

headline: Save $800 Off This Top-Tier iBuypower Gaming PC With AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D CPU and 5090 GPU
summary: Get an iBuypower gaming PC with an AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D CPU and 5090 GPU for $800 off. The PC features 32GB DDR5-6000MHz RAM and a 4TB SSD. It comes with a 3-year warranty for peace of mind.

headline: Amazon Has Box Set Deals Hidden Deep Within Its BOGO 50% Off Book Sale
summary: Amazon's current BOGO 50% off book sale includes hidden deals on box sets. Shoppers can find significant savings on popular series and collections. This offers a chance to expand your library at a reduced price.

headline: Multiple deaths after collision between police vehicle and car
summary: A collision involving a police vehicle and another car resulted in multiple fatalities on Teesside. Police are working to identify the victims. Authorities are also contacting the families of those involved.

headline: Canada says it will match US tariffs 'dollar for dollar' as trade talks break down
summary: Trade talks between the US and Canada have collapsed. Canada announced it will impose matching tariffs on US imports. This follows a new 50% US levy on $20bn of Canadian goods.

headline: TikTok to pay $400m to US in one of largest child privacy settlements
summary: TikTok will pay $400 million to the US, settling a child privacy lawsuit. The 2024 lawsuit alleged the company collected data from users under 13. This marks one of the largest child privacy settlements to date.

headline: Girl, 6, dies days after Shoreham sea tragedy killed three family members
summary: A 6-year-old girl, Saja El-Khawas, has died following a sea tragedy off West Sussex. She is the fourth family member to perish after getting into difficulty in the water. The incident previously claimed the lives of three other family members.
